da-non-sequitur.evidence: [sidecar review 2026-11-15, issue #8030] Library ref `QOU.Experimental.LocalSubstrateQ` is a `def … : Prop` (\ | q − q_measured\ | ≤ Δq), never asserted. The sibling structure carries `defining_eq` and `q_approx` as fields; no theorem states existence or uniqueness of the root. Checked: the unique root of (1−q⁻¹)² = Vol(4₁)/(m_μ/m_e) with CODATA-2022 206.7682827 is 1.109978595642739… (matches the live anchor). The md's "q = 1.1097 ± 0.001" contains it (difference 2.8e−4), but 1.10998 does not round to 1.1097. prf: uniqueness argument (f(q) = (1−q⁻¹)² strictly increasing) is correct. "The ±0.001 propagates from the CODATA uncertainty (2.2e−8)" is wrong: that propagates to ~1e−9 on q; ±0.001 is a chosen tolerance. "Aligns with hadronic mass predictions" is an empirical remark inside a proof.
